verdict.rationale: Increase documents origination for wires (POST /wire_transfers), Real-Time Payments, and FedNow, each on its own per-rail docs page. It also documents reachability checks through the Routing Numbers API with fallback to ACH or wire. Receipt of wires and RTP is evidenced, but FedNow receipt is not, so the story is not fully covered. missing for 10: evidence of FedNow receipt, a consolidated per-rail capability/limits comparison, independent hands-on corroboration of RTP/FedNow flows.

support.subject: As a developer, the faster rails are there when I need them — domestic wires, RTP, and FedNow origination and receipt through the same API, with per-rail capabilities documented

citations.quote: You make a `POST /wire_transfers` call with the details of how much you'd like to send and data about the recipient.
Real-Time Payments can be sent at any time during the day and funds will settle instantly.
You can use the Routing Numbers API to confirm whether an institution supports Real-Time Payments.
Sending FedNow transfers covers how to check reachability with the Routing Number endpoint and fall back to ACH or a wire.
regardless of how they send funds (via Wire, RTP, ACH, or even Check)
receive funds via ACH, wires, checks or Real-Time Payments
